root_cause.text: The ATA libata device driver fails to cancel the pending deferred_qc_work when clearing ap->deferred_qc, allowing a stale work item to execute later under changed port conditions and trigger a WARN_ON when qc_defer() returns non-zero.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description explicitly states: "the code currently does not cancel the work after clearing the deferred qc" and describes a scenario where clearing deferred_qc (step 4) leads to the old work running later (step 8) and causing a WARN_ON. The patch adds cancel_work(&ap->deferred_qc_work) after each ap->deferred_qc = NULL in both libata-eh.c and libata-scsi.c.
